Name: Pelican Town Clerks - Abby and Thompson Work at Pierre's
Author: AndrewJamesC
Description:
[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size][/color]
Pelican Town Clerks adds a new event where Pierre hires Abigail and (Optionally) Thompson as employees of the general store to keep up with demand after the closing of Joja, adjusting the schedule of all 3. Abigail always works Tuesday, and will work Wednesday when Thompson isn't installed. If Thompson is installed, he'll work Wednesday and Sunday.
Clerks doesn't adjust any of the hours or inventory of the shop, just the schedules of villagers working as a cashier.

[color=#f4cccc][size=4][b][u]Compatibility and Credits[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14585]A Pelican Town[/url] isn't required to use this mod, but I did make it with Thompson in mind, hence his use in the pictures. It works just fine without  though!
